properties.name: panama_canal_core
properties.description: Panama Canal event AOI: the main transit corridor from the Pacific-side entrance through the canal system (Miraflores / Pedro Miguel locks, Gaillard Cut, Gatun Lake) toward the Atlantic-side Gatun locks.
properties.navigation_rationale: Covers the canal system where the drought restrictions bound daily transit slots; chosen from the navigation geography before any matching-rate result for this area was inspected.
properties.caveat: The box contains substantial land (canal watershed). The footprint-derived water-observable denominator must be used for coverage, not the bounding-box area.
